title: Pen Plotter — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Plot the idea, then the system
scenes.purpose: Show a pen plotter turning an idea (bulb) into a connected system (node network), with visible pen lifts and no ink during travel on a fixed, registered sheet.
visuals: Stationary dark plotter bed with registered off-white sheet and four registration marks
Static title 'An idea becomes a connected system' and footer 'PLOT 07 · 0.3 MM DRY PEN · SHEET REGISTERED'
Moving gantry bridge, carriage and pen head; ink paths revealed by stroke length
Live status line showing PEN DOWN / PEN UP

beats.development: Pen lowers onto the top of the bulb contour; status shows pen up homing.
Three nested bulb contours, the base threads and the filament are traced by path length; the pen lifts, pauses and travels between each without ink.
Long pen-up travel from the filament to the network, then one continuous trail ringing each node and drawing links 01–08; pen lifts to swap to red and draws link 09 to the new node.
Pen lifts off the red node and the full plot holds settled for reading.

findings: Brisk constant-speed plotting with short lift pauses; all ink completes by 2.5 s and the scene is settled by 2.62 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.62–3.0 s: final reading hold of the finished plot and title.

notes: No reviewed preview recipes exist in STYLE.json; the core Pen Plotter characteristic action is demonstrated.
All state derives from GSAP timeline time via a pure render(time); hf-seek re-renders.
